About Swastik

Rooted in nature.
Created for today.

Natural-inspired personal care from Swastik Veda Naturals LLP, created with an everyday Indian self-care mindset.

The people behind Swastik

Family-guided,
everyday-minded.

Our thinking is shaped by the simple care rituals families have carried forward for generations, brought into a clean, modern routine for 2026.

Swastik Veda Naturals LLP is building a focused personal-care range around familiar botanical ingredients such as Multani Mitti, Neem, Tulsi, Rose, Aloe Vera, Turmeric, Sandalwood and Bhringraj.

We keep the approach straightforward: thoughtful products, clear communication, and support that is easy to reach when you are deciding what fits your routine.
